source: the raw records of the runners of GitHub, judged again with the catalog after the calibration of the propagation

cells.name: iptables, callers learn that a shared dependency is black-holed: endpoints only

prediction.text: The algebra predicts that the Service has no ready endpoint, and that the rules of each node have no backend. The band is 12 s to 26.105 s after the fault. Redis is black-holed for each replica for the hold (27 s). Each request needs Redis, thus each request fails from the fault until the callers recover. Before the readiness latch of a replica trips (8 s–20 s), each request on it waits for Redis and fails slowly. Then its controller is not ready, and the service refuses each request at once with a 503. The kubelet and the propagation (CAL.T07.iptables: median 0.059 s, 33 times) remove both replicas 12 s–26.105 s after the fault. Then the Service is empty, and its rules refuse each new connection. Each connection of A stays open on its replica, thus it gets the 503 of the service and no refusal. After the heal, the client of Redis connects again in 3.1 s at the most, and the readiness of the service recovers up to 6 s later. Then A succeeds on its open connections, before the endpoints come back. Each client sends a request each 20 ms, thus about 3954–5742 requests fail.

cells.why: Each of the 3 counted runs agrees with the prediction. The median is 18.165 s. The counted runs measured 16.833 s to 19.211 s.
